title: The Haveli Courtyard Secret
briefing: During Diwali festivities at a heritage haveli in Rajasthan, a priceless Mughal jade dagger was taken from the display alcove. Four guests were near the courtyard, and one of them is guilty.

suspects.name: Sameer Rathore
suspects.publicStatement: I was examining brass lamps in the library alcove.
suspects.background: Dealer with connections to foreign auctions.

suspects.name: Ananya Sharma
suspects.publicStatement: I was on the terrace taking notes on palace architecture.

suspects.name: Rajiv Rathore
suspects.publicStatement: I was in the accounting room auditing festive accounts.
suspects.background: Oversees the haveli lands and staff.

suspects.name: Pooja Varma
suspects.publicStatement: I was tuning sitars in the music chamber.
suspects.background: Renowned classical musician invited for the evening.

clues.title: Library Motion Sensor Log
clues.description: Sensors recorded no movement in the library alcove after 8:35 PM, contradicting Sameer's claim.
clues.insight: Dismantles Sameer's claim of spending the hour studying brass lamps.

clues.title: Terrace Sketchbook Timecode
clues.description: Timestamped camera footage and dated sketchbook entries verify Ananya was on the roof terrace continuously.
clues.insight: Exonerates Ananya by proving her location on the upper roof.

clues.title: Accounting Safe Log
clues.description: Cash receipt stamps and security cameras confirm Rajiv was locked inside the accounting office.
clues.insight: Corroborates Rajiv's presence inside the accounting office during the theft.

clues.title: Displaced Sitar Tuning Key
clues.description: A bronze musical key found on the floor near the alcove, belonging to Pooja's instrument case.
clues.insight: Appears incriminating, but was dropped when instruments were loaded earlier.

clues.title: Estate Dispute Letter
clues.description: A heated letter regarding renovation expenses, showing tension between brothers.
clues.insight: Suggests motive, but Rajiv's alibi remains airtight.

clues.title: Velvet Scabbard Fiber
clues.description: Fine strands of antique crimson velvet matching the dagger case found trapped in Sameer's cufflink.
clues.insight: Directly links Sameer to handling the vintage velvet scabbard.

clues.title: Swiss Wire Transfer Order
clues.description: Encrypted text confirming a fifty percent down payment for an authentic Mughal relic.
clues.insight: Proves Sameer had already lined up an international buyer.

motive: Sameer arranged to sell the rare dagger to an overseas collector for a fortune.
method: Slipped out during fireworks, pried the alcove glass, and concealed the dagger in his coat.
opportunity: Haveli darkness during fireworks and his appraisal role gave him quiet access.

deduction.conclusion: Sensor records prove Sameer was not in the library during his alibi window.
Velvet fibers from the scabbard caught on Sameer's cuff prove he handled the relic.
Encrypted bank messages confirm Sameer had negotiated a private sale.

timeline.event: Sameer leaves the library and enters the courtyard shadows.
Sameer slips the dagger from the alcove under cover of fireworks.
Sameer stashes the blade inside his luggage.

hints.text: Check motion sensors to verify who vacated their designated room.
Examine the cuff fabrics of guests for traces of display materials.
Review encrypted messages to find who had an advance buyer waiting.
